description:
TESTNET only: how to get the test settlement token (TestUSD, hUSD-test, no value). Returns the faucet call (to, data =
        faucet(): a fixed amount to the caller once per cooldown), the account's balance and next draw time when readable, and the
        onboarding steps: connect -> faucet -> deposit -> session key -> quote -> fill. Read-only: your own wallet sends the call.
        Mainnet answers not_on_mainnet (see how_to_deposit).
name: how_to_get_test_funds
